senses.gloss: m. (comp. of דּוּר a. שיני, pl. of שִׁינָּא) [row of teeth,] gum.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 65a:7">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>לד׳</he> (some ed. <he>לדורשו׳</he>, incorr.; Ms. M. <he>דורשני</he>, Var. a. Ar. in two words, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a remedy for the gum. Cmp. <cite ref="D01126"><he>דְּרָרָא</he> I</cite>.
